method.catalog_selection: Available Office/ACL skills do not match rigid robot static geometry; use inspected existing MuJoCo factory, public closed-chain setter and sealed NumPy collision-support API. No old validator or controller entry is run.
method.robot_factory: physics_bridge.model_factory(step=False), unchanged source XML and original options, no Plant/FullDR/controller/DARE construction; factory transient compiler meshdir/IMU site behavior unchanged
method.compiled_support_API: PRIVATE_COLLISION_SUPPORT_V1.support.CompiledCollisionSupport(model).bounds(data,stage_time_s=data.time), cached transforms only, original mask OR explicit-pair selector; 34 expected collision geoms, exact compiled vertex support/analytic primitives, no shell/force/stability inference
method.root_convention: MuJoCo root freejoint qpos[3:7] is unit w,x,y,z mapping regular BODY axes into world; fixture uses its exact saved quaternion. Extract initial pitch atan2(-R20,hypot(R00,R10)), cross-check saved final_rpy without inventing a new acceptance gate. Public poses use [cos(p/2),0,sin(p/2),0], roll=yaw=0 and authored qpos0 rootXYZ before seating.
method.fixture: STARTUP_STAND_V1/passive_settle001/front_rest_065/result.json final_qpos/final_qvel copied exactly into NEW MjData for one geometric forward; original file never changed, no saved raw opened
method.public_q_conversion: gain.q7 -> absolute q4=[q3,q3+q4,q5,q5+q6]. Common +/-initialPitch adds same signed angle to all4 absolute coordinates, preserving crank-minus-hip delta.
method.closure: Public kinematics.set_configuration(model,data,(hL,deltaL),(hR,deltaR),check_limits=False) uses original continuous branch and sets all mapped passive/mimic/gas coordinates then calls exactly ONE mj_forward. Root pose set BEFORE it. Limits evaluated and violations retained separately; False is not permission to relabel an invalid reference as legal. Fixture keeps actual saved passive state, no nominal replacement.
method.phase: Fixture keeps saved actual wheel/guide phases. Public poses start from mj_resetData qpos0: wheel spin explicitly0 by public setter, eight guide phases canonical0; save all values. Zero phases are synthetic fixtures, not measured/phase-independent hardware bounds.
method.geometry: Per-geom current-world raw min/max from compiled support. Main=left_tire/right_tire; guide=name guide_wheel_; hard=all remaining selected nonworld collision geoms. Save class minZ/arggeom plus all per-geom bounds; classify before any success inference.
method.analytic_seating: dz=-min(main minZ L,R). Translate cached extrema, rootXYZ, subtreeCOM and tire center by [0,0,dz] analytically only; no second forward/no actual data root rewrite. One lowest tire touches plane z0 geometrically; report residual gap for both tires, do not independently seat them or infer actual support.
method.COM_reference: Whole robot subtree_com[chassis] from same forward; primary COMx offset from mean cached main-tire geom origin; also report wheel-body axle midpoint and its x offset. These are geometric references, not contact support polygon/certificate.
method.limits_and_reference: Report all compiled limited joints (hinges rad/slides m), four active absolute joint limits, driver delta[-1.0843,.85]. No altered range, no projection of measured fixture. 2s quintic per-axis peak=1.875*abs(q_goal-q_start)/2; minimum duration=1.875*maxabsdifference for speed<=1rad/s. Save both actual initial and original V1 reference-only projection starts; target invalid remains invalid. Endpoint-only check is not swept-path feasibility.
method.numeric_policy: Preserve float64 SI raw values, original support padding1e-8 separately. No new mechanical success threshold. Unit quaternion and saved angle consistency sanity tolerance1e-12rad; cached transforms validated by unchanged support library. Invalid geometry or API/budget error stops once and preserves prefix, no automatic fix/rerun.
method.lock_and_persistence: Source/method/inputs pinned before NumPy/MuJoCo/model query. Preserve exact runner before run. Per-row raw numeric prefix and actual count snapshot written exclusively before narrative; final small-source before/after SHA equality.
method.forbidden: No integrator, controller command, old QA/validator, DR sample/attach, gain synthesis, raw/asset hash, Git/agents/hardware; no existing source/model/score/gate edit. SDK asset loading only required by one approved compile, not a 279-file digest sweep.
method.qualification: Static geometric seating/COM/endpoint speed only. No actual load/contact stability, guide-unload sensor permission, fullDR dynamics/standup/hardware phase certificate. No V4 target/gain or physical case approved; excluded from current PH10 cutoff.

parent_scope.closure: Set passive linkage states through the same audited public kinematic branch used for nominal synthesis, not by ignoring closure/mimic. Save all commanded/actual geometric q and closure/mimic residuals. Invalid geometry/limits remains INVALID, not silently projected into success.
parent_scope.guide_and_tire_phase: Explicitly document fixture versus canonical passive wheel/guide phase choice. No hardware phase binding or all-orientation support certificate. Preserve source robot meshes/contacts/limits; no refitting or changed tire radius.
geometry_only_outputs: Current-world minZ of each main tire and minZ/arggeom of guide and hard-body collision sets using exact compiled mesh and analytic primitives

All guide/hard minZ and arggeom AFTER the same analytic translation; no second mj_forward needed just to translate cached extrema
Resulting hypothetical wheel-supported rootZ and wholeCOM x offset from main tire midpoint, if available from the single updated cache
Active absolute q4/delta, legal unchanged joint/driver boxes, initial-to-goal 2s quintic peak reference rate and minimum duration needed for <=1rad/s
Separate static geometric clearance from actual contact/load/stability; do not call positive clearance a stand-up success or bound true DR motion
parent_scope.allowed_reuse: Read task-matched tools/skill catalog first. parent_scope.preservation: Keep all sealed sources, model, old proof/case IDs and scores unchanged; source hashes before/after on actual small dependencies. No model mutation except data for NEW static counterfactuals. No contact truth input to any controller; no estimator/driver loop or attach_DR.
parent_scope.receipt: Save minimum numerical results and actual counts before long prose, report <=30 lines plus local source links. Error receipts retain counts/prefix and no rerun in this grant. PH10 archive cutoff excludes this new active study.
